# Code Anchors: Story as Unit

- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — sizes each story, rolls epic complexity up from the filed story set, and stops decomposing at the story.
- `components/skills/nxs-gh-create-story/SKILL.md` — files one issue per user story, linked under the epic.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/rollup.ts` — reads each story's size out of the draft and takes the floor the filed set forces.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/check.ts` — blocks a filed story that states no size, because the rollup cannot be derived without it.
